watched #LoveToday : Finally got time to watch this movie on Big Screen…..MAN!!! Relevant Content to the current world with a Beautiful message conveyed in an entertaining way!!!!

It doesn’t matter where and how you watch this movie….but its a Must Watch for each one of us who are so addicted to our mobiles which have been an integral part of our life and feel uncomfortable in sharing our mobile with anyone even for a fraction of a minute!!!

Each and every actor and technician has done justice to the wonderful script. While writing the review I searched for the technical team and am surprised to see that main lead Pradeep Ranganathan has also Written& Directed this movie 🙏🙏🙏
